title: Typing: generics (PEP 695), Protocol, TypedDict
hints: class Stack[T]: def __init__(self) -> None: self._items: list[T] = [] ... def __len__(self) -> int, def __bool__(self) -> bool.
@runtime_checkable class HasArea(Protocol): def area(self) -> float: ...  — any class with an area() method matches, no inheritance needed.
